Chart footnote "Preview (05-06)". The 72.5/72.7 bases match the prose values exactly.

notes: Release date 2025-05-22: the article page prints no date; taken from the official Anthropic newsroom index entry "May 22, 2025 - Introducing Claude 4" (tier A, same domain) and consistent with model snapshot IDs claude-opus-4-20250514 / claude-sonnet-4-20250514 in platform.claude.com docs. Benchmark numbers are mostly prose-level; the SWE-bench Verified comparison is a chart image (second row records it with not_extracted). Not turned into rows: 65% reduction in shortcut/loophole behaviors vs Sonnet 3.7 (internal agentic-safety eval); Opus 4 Pokemon memory demo; customer quotes (Cursor, Replit, Block, Rakuten, Cognition, GitHub, Manus, iGent, Sourcegraph, Augment) carrying no benchmark scores; ASL-3 protections; pricing Opus 4 USD 15/75 and Sonnet 4 USD 3/15 per MTok.
